title: 2 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on 2 Corinthians 4: preaching Christ Jesus as Lord, the treasure in clay vessels, and the inward man renewed day by day.

questions.text: What does the writer say they have renounced, and how do they not handle the word of God?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says they have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but commending themselves by the manifestation of the truth.

answers.text: They have renounced letters of commendation and all preaching
They have renounced the old covenant written on stone
They have renounced the hidden things of shame and do not handle the word of God deceitfully
They have renounced preaching in public and speak only in secret

questions.text: Who has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, so that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ should not dawn on them.

answers.text: The god of this world
The children of Israel
The servants of the letter
Those who peddle the word of God

questions.text: What do they preach, and as what do they present themselves?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says they do not preach themselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and themselves as your servants for Jesus' sake.

answers.text: They preach the law, and present themselves as teachers
They preach Christ Jesus as Lord, and themselves as servants of the Corinthians
They preach themselves, and present themselves as apostles
They preach Moses, and present themselves as judges

questions.text: What words of God does verse 6 quote?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says it is God who said, "Light will shine out of darkness", who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

answers.text: "I will dwell in them and walk in them"
"Death is swallowed up in victory"
"I believed, and therefore I spoke"
"Light will shine out of darkness"

questions.text: In what does the text say this treasure is held, and why?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says they have this treasure in clay vessels, so that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from themselves.

answers.text: In clay vessels, so that the greatness of the power may be of God
In tablets of stone, so that it may last forever
In a sealed letter, so that no one may read it
In hearts of flesh, so that men may praise them

questions.text: How does verse 8 describe their situation?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says they are pressed on every side, yet not crushed, and perplexed, yet not to despair.

answers.text: Honored on every side, at ease and without trouble
Pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair
Hidden away, unknown to all and never pursued
Crushed on every side and left without any hope

questions.text: What does verse 12 say works in them, and what works in the Corinthians?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says: So then death works in us, but life in you.

answers.text: Fear works in them, but boldness in the Corinthians
Sorrow works in them, but joy in the Corinthians
The letter works in them, but the Spirit in the Corinthians
Death works in them, but life in the Corinthians

questions.text: What written words does the writer quote as the same spirit of faith?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 quotes that which is written, "I believed, and therefore I spoke", and adds that they also believe and therefore also speak.

answers.text: "He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor"
"I believed, and therefore I spoke"
"He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord"
"At an acceptable time I listened to you"

questions.text: What does verse 16 say about the outward man and the inward man?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says that though the outward man is decaying, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

answers.text: The outward man is decaying, yet the inward man is renewed day by day
Both the outward and the inward man are decaying
The outward man is renewed, but the inward man grows weak
Both are already made new and need no renewing

questions.text: What does verse 18 say about the things which are seen and the things which are not seen?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

answers.text: Both the things which are seen and the unseen are eternal
The things which are seen are eternal, the unseen are temporal
The things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal
Neither the seen nor the unseen things can be known at all
